about: The vis feature's items. A wand is a tool of magic made of a rod and two caps; the chime rod and the Resonant Brass cap are tuned metal parts. The node block is exempt: a node's aspects are its own state, read through the node source, never a block value.

blocks.vftv:node: a node's aspects are its own state, read through the node source; never obtainable as an item
